guarantees.claim: All combinational outputs are assigned inactive default values (0 or current state copies) before the case; no implicit latching.
In KeccakStIdle with valid_i asserted, xor_message=1, update_storage=1, keccak_st_d remains Idle.
In KeccakStIdle with clear_i true (strict multibit), rst_storage=1, keccak_st_d remains Idle.
In KeccakStIdle with EnMasking and run_i, keccak_st_d goes to KeccakStPhase1, dom_in_low_d = low_then_high_q, dom_in_rand_ext_d = 0.
In KeccakStIdle with !EnMasking and run_i, keccak_st_d goes to KeccakStActive.
In KeccakStIdle with no active trigger (else), keccak_st_d remains Idle.
In KeccakStActive, update_storage=1; if rnd_eq_end then keccak_st_d=Idle, rst_rnd_num=1, complete_d=1; else keccak_st_d=Active, inc_rnd_num=1.

In KeccakStPhase1, if rand_early_i or rand_valid_i, keccak_st_d = KeccakStPhase2Cycle1, update_storage=1, keccak_rand_update=1, low_then_high_d = rand_aux_i, dom_in_low_d = low_then_high_d (newly assigned), dom_in_rand_ext_d=1; otherwise stays Phase1.
In KeccakStPhase2Cycle1, phase_sel=MuBi4True, dom_update=1, keccak_rand_update=1, unconditionally moves to KeccakStPhase2Cycle2, dom_in_low_d = ~low_then_high_q, dom_in_rand_ext_d = 1.

In KeccakStPhase2Cycle2, phase_sel=MuBi4True, dom_update=1, keccak_rand_update=1, keccak_rand_consumed=1, update_storage=1, unconditionally moves to KeccakStPhase2Cycle3, dom_in_low_d = low_then_high_q, dom_in_rand_ext_d = 0.

In KeccakStPhase2Cycle3, phase_sel=MuBi4True, dom_update=0, update_storage=1; if rnd_eq_end then keccak_st_d=Idle, rst_rnd_num=1, complete_d=1; else keccak_st_d=Phase1, inc_rnd_num=1, dom_in_low_d = low_then_high_q, dom_in_rand_ext_d = 0.
In KeccakStError, keccak_st_d stays KeccakStError, no other outputs set.
In KeccakStTerminalError, keccak_st_d stays TerminalError, sparse_fsm_error_o = 1.
If keccak_st is not one of the enumerated states (default), keccak_st_d = KeccakStTerminalError, sparse_fsm_error_o = 1.
After the case, if lc_escalate_en_i is true (loose multibit test), keccak_st_d forced to KeccakStTerminalError regardless of any prior assignment.

assumptions.claim: valid_i is only asserted when external logic provides valid message data for xor_message/update_storage.
assumptions.risk: Random or stale data absorbed into Keccak state, potentially compromising integrity or causing functional failure.

assumptions.claim: In Phase1, rand_early_i or rand_valid_i eventually assert to allow transition to Phase2Cycle1.
assumptions.risk: FSM deadlocks in Phase1, stalling Keccak round processing; system hangs.

assumptions.claim: EnMasking is static during operation; switching between masked/unmasked paths while active may cause state inconsistency.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect state transitions (e.g., entering masked path with unmasked-data setup) could compromise SCA countermeasure or produce wrong results.

assumptions.claim: lc_escalate_en_i is a stable, glitch-free indication of a fatal lifecycle error.
assumptions.risk: A spurious escalation forces the FSM into KeccakStTerminalError, causing denial of service; if the escalation is ignored or missed, security-critical condition may go unhandled.

assumptions.claim: The PRNG and DOM multiplier instances deliver fresh randomness synchronously with keccak_rand_update so that data and entropy updates coincide, preventing SCA leakage.
assumptions.risk: Stale entropy paired with fresh data or vice versa may lead to exploitable power side-channel leakage.

uncertain_points.claim: The clear_i handling is implemented only in Idle state, but the comment mentions two options (reset only in Idle vs reset regardless of state). It is unclear which option is intended, leaving potential for incomplete storage clearing if clear_i is asserted in non-Idle states.
uncertain_points.cond: clear_i asserted while not in KeccakStIdle
uncertain_points.risk: Sensitive state may not be cleared, violating zeroization or security wipe requirements.

uncertain_points.claim: When lc_escalate_en_i forces keccak_st_d to KeccakStTerminalError, sparse_fsm_error_o is not asserted in the same cycle; it only becomes 1 when the next state is TerminalError. This delays error signaling by one clock cycle.
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream error handlers may miss the immediate fault indication, potentially allowing an operation to proceed with corrupted state.

uncertain_points.claim: KeccakStError state exists in the FSM but within this block it is never entered (no transition to it); its behavior is to stay in the same state without asserting sparse_fsm_error_o. It may be dead code or unreachable.
uncertain_points.risk: If the state is unintentionally reached via external corruption, the block would silently stay in Error without signaling, violating the error reporting contract. The missing transition might also indicate an incomplete error handling design.

uncertain_points.claim: The SCA leakage prevention depends on simultaneous application of storage and randomness updates inside keccak_2share. The block asserts keccak_rand_update and update_storage concurrently, but if the target module lags one of them, the pairing may break.
uncertain_points.risk: Mismatched data/entropy leads to exploitable side-channel leakage, undermining the masking countermeasure.
